assertion.statement: The three domain filtrations permit replacing G0 by the subgroup generated by their first positive groups after normalizing the polynomial at zero.
assertion.objects: Degree Z^a, multidegree Z^a, degree-rank Z; rational target G_i; H=G1, <G_ej>_R, or G_(1,0).
assertion.hypotheses: Finite degree downset, connected rational groups, derivative polynomial definition and inherited commutator/nesting axioms.
assertion.quantifiers: Every polynomial nilsequence for one of the three domains. In the nilcharacter clause vertical equivariance holds for all limit points and all limit top-group elements, under the natural ultrapower extension; standard-only identities are not used to infer it.
assertion.parameter_range: Any fixed finite dimension and finite degree downset; integer inputs of arbitrary size.
assertion.uniformity: Same fixed H and positive groups for all polynomial coefficients.
assertion.constants: Fixed metric comparison constants only; no analytic threshold or error.
assertion.normalizations: Only the index-zero group changes; all positive groups and their intersections with the original lattice remain the same. Degree support does not enlarge, but actual nontrivial support at zero can shrink.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Trivial positive groups give a point nilmanifold; positive-degree nilcharacters retain their top group.
assertion.limit_order: Fix structural data first, normalize each polynomial, then restrict its orbit.

assertion.statement: The generated subgroup H is connected, closed, simply connected and rational; bounded normalization preserves values, Lipschitz bounds and the same standard vertical character.
assertion.objects: H, H intersect Gamma, g0=q gamma, h=q^-1 g gamma^-1, F_q(x)=F(qx).
assertion.hypotheses: Original rational filtered nilmanifold; q from a fixed compact representative set; unit-norm vertical test function for the character claim.
assertion.quantifiers: Every admissible g and F; every q from that set.
assertion.parameter_range: All three degree types; arbitrary coefficients; positive top degree for the character clause.
assertion.uniformity: Geometric data and constants independent of polynomial coefficients and family parameter.
assertion.constants: Lip(F_q restricted H) bounded by a fixed geometric multiple of Lip(F).
assertion.normalizations: The lattice is the exact intersection, not a q-conjugate lattice; eta_q=eta is proved by integer continuity and lattice spanning.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No original tautness or original top centrality assumed in normalization.
assertion.limit_order: This unit depends on the separately frozen local geometric argument; its pending acceptance is not bypassed.

assertion.statement: Products of polynomial maps into the same valid filtration remain polynomial, and the derivative in a domain direction of degree i is polynomial into the i-shifted filtration.
assertion.objects: h=q^-1(g g0^-1)q and P_u(n)=U(partial_u g(n)) D(g(n)).
assertion.hypotheses: First prove the relevant filtrations are descending and satisfy commutators; u is in the domain group at positive index i.
assertion.quantifiers: Every finite product and every such u.
assertion.parameter_range: Degree, multidegree and degree-rank domain filtrations as explicitly stated.
assertion.uniformity: Algebraic identities valid for all inputs and family parameters.
assertion.normalizations: partial_u g(n)=g(n+u)g(n)^-1; the derivative u is innermost in iterated derivatives.
assertion.exceptional_cases: For degree-rank a nonzero positive-domain direction is at index (1,0); if u=0 that same index is used.
assertion.limit_order: Validate filtration before applying product closure.

assertion.statement: Tautification preserves the nilsequence class and lower-degree equivalence relation; a maximal top group is central and the class is bounded by total degree.
assertion.objects: Taut H and its unchanged positive filtration groups G_i; maximal index d or finite downset J.
assertion.hypotheses: H is generated by first positive groups and support is finite.
assertion.quantifiers: Every admissible finite degree support; every positive degree d with support below d.
assertion.parameter_range: Class <=d for degree/rank and <=max |a| over J for multidegree.
assertion.uniformity: The bound depends only on the fixed degree support.
assertion.constants: Exact class upper bound, no asymptotic constant.
assertion.normalizations: Commutator lengths count first positive generators; maximal means support lies below that single d.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Centrality of G_d is not asserted for a non-maximal d in a general multidegree downset.
assertion.limit_order: Use the normalized taut representation before claiming top centrality.

assertion.statement: The pair filtration L_j=<U(G_(j+i)),D(G_j)> is rational and filtered; quotient by L_d=D(G_d) gives the exact shifted tensor product on support strictly below d.
assertion.objects: U(v)=(v,1), D(v)=(v,v), Delta=L0 intersect Gamma^2, P_u=(g(n+u),g(n)), T=F tensor conjugate F.
assertion.hypotheses: Taut input of degree <=d; i>0; G_(d+i)=1; same vertical character in both factors.
assertion.quantifiers: Every permitted u and every input n.
assertion.parameter_range: All three actual domain types; degree-rank uses i=(1,0) to preserve its extra equalities.
assertion.uniformity: Groups and quotient fixed independently of u; a final bounded normalization gives a limit choice and fixed Lipschitz bound.
assertion.constants: No approximation or correlation loss; support loses the maximal index d exactly.
assertion.normalizations: Two vertical characters cancel; quotient lattice is the image of the exact intersection; final tautification changes no sequence values.
assertion.exceptional_cases: u=0 remains covered by the same construction; the tensor need not be a constant vector.
assertion.limit_order: Normalize input, construct pair and prove its filtration, form central quotient, and tautify the output.
